verdict.rationale: Docs confirm that Retell stores per-call transcripts and recordings (referenced in data-retention docs) and that full voice/chat API endpoint coverage exists via official SDKs, implying programmatic retrieval, but no evidence pack item explicitly documents a 'get call' or 'list calls' API endpoint returning recording URLs/transcript text, nor examples of pulling them via SDK/CLI. Missing for 10: explicit API reference for call/recording/transcript retrieval endpoints, CLI/SDK code samples showing recording download or transcript fetch, and any independent confirmation of this working end-to-end.
